lines.zh: 我踮着脚在玄武岩上走。
lines.en: I walk on tiptoe across the basalt.

lines.zh: 脚下的石头是烫的，我不在乎。
lines.en: The stone is hot underfoot. I do not mind.
My little wings beat very fast.

lines.zh: 我在岩浆边上跳来跳去。
lines.en: I skip about at the edge of the lava.
A little fire burns at my tail tip.

lines.zh: 我边走边发出尖细的笑。
lines.en: I giggle shrilly as I walk.

lines.zh: 我从火里穿过去，身上没焦。
lines.en: I walk through the flames unburnt.

lines.zh: 我绕过熔岩池，脚步很熟。
lines.en: I skirt the lava pool with practised steps.

lines.zh: 我的影子被火光照得乱跳。
lines.en: Firelight makes my shadow jump about.

lines.zh: 我跑到岩柱后面躲了一下。
lines.en: I run behind a basalt pillar and hide.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了一块焦黑的石头。
lines.en: I crush a piece of charred stone.
I toss a small fireball as I walk.
I turn a fireball over in my hands.
I wait for someone to come near the lava.
My teeth are small and sharp.
I squat on a basalt pillar, swinging my legs.
Firelight wheels in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔手指上的火星。
lines.en: I lick sparks off my fingers.
These wastes are always hot.

lines.zh: 我张开手掌，火苗升起来。
lines.en: I open my palm and a flame rises.

lines.zh: 我听着熔岩冒泡的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the lava bubbling.
I fold my little wings behind me.
You are standing on my ground.
I am fiercer than I look.
My fireballs need no aiming.
I am wondering whether you will catch fire.
My fireball is ready.

lines.zh: 你退开，我就少烧你一下。
lines.en: Step back and I will burn you one time less.

lines.zh: 这里的地面比你的鞋热。
lines.en: The ground here is hotter than your boots.
From up here you are easy to watch.
I laughed when you looked up.
There are gaps in your armor's seams.
I let out a piercing shriek.
I hop back, clutching my shoulder.
My flame dimmed for a moment.
I retreat behind a basalt pillar.
That cut off my laughing.

lines.zh: 血滴在热石上，嗞了一声。
lines.en: Blood drips onto hot stone and hisses.
Half my flame is out; I can still burn.
I grit my teeth, wings trembling.
You hit me. Very interesting.
I will repay that twice over.
That smells like blaze powder.
I do not eat that. I eat fire.
Your hands smell of sparks.
This offering has no sincerity.
I touch it. It is cold.
Throw it in the fire and I will accept it.
Back off, or you will be burnt.
This would look better burning.
Keep this one yourself.
I accept your kindness with a grin.

lines.zh: 火星落了一地，你躲开点。
lines.en: Sparks hit the floor. Stay back.
The impact made me hop.
The fire on my tail swayed.
I am light; I cannot hurt you that way.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我身上有火。
lines.en: Not so close; I'm made of fire.
Sparks landed on your sleeve.
I squeak and hop aside.

lines.zh: 我们擦身过去，都带着热气。
lines.en: We pass close, both trailing heat.
You back off; my fire still burns.
That bump made me laugh out loud.
I will follow and light fires for you.
You draw it in; I throw fire.
We take opposite sides of the lava.
My fireball will not burn you.
If you fear fire, stand further off.
I will keep you behind the basalt pillar.
We laugh together and watch it burn.
You take close range; I take the far.
You need not carry me; I fly fast.
When the fun is done, we go back to the fire.
Two fingers pinch it up.
This stone is hot. Just right.
I toss it in my mouth and chew twice.
This is not edible. I spit it out.
I hold it over the fire a moment.

lines.zh: 我把它烤热了再收起来。
lines.en: I scorch it warm, then pocket it.
I hold it by the fire to show you.
This is too cold to hold comfortably.
I tuck it into the pouch at my waist.
It fell in the lava. Gone.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，就在岩浆那边。
lines.en: I see you, there past the lava.

lines.zh: 火球在我掌心里鼓起来。
lines.en: A fireball swells in my palm.
A fireball spins in my palm.
You cannot back away; there is lava behind you.
I will throw one to test.
This distance is just right.
You are downwind. Bad for you.
My laughter is for my companions.
You stand against the glow. Easy to find.
I need not come close to hit you.
This time I will aim more carefully.

lines.zh: 你听见火球的响声了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear the fireball?

lines.zh: 你跑的方向有我的同伴。
lines.en: There are companions of mine where you are running.

lines.zh: 这座岩柱后面看不见你。
lines.en: I cannot see you behind that pillar.
The small fireball comes from the other side.
Now — catch this.
Do not think of climbing up here.
I shift position on the pillars.

lines.zh: 我的火球只追一个方向。
lines.en: My fireball chases one direction.
I have gathered another fireball.
Iron burns. You'll let go.

lines.zh: 我等你的脚踩到岩浆边。
lines.en: I wait for your foot to reach the lava's edge.
I mark every jump you make.
The lava's light gives me away.
I crouch and fly lower.
Your panting is loud enough to hear.
That shield is too small.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳数你的步子。
lines.en: I count your steps hop by hop.

lines.zh: 你身后的岩壁挡了退路。
lines.en: The rock wall behind you blocks the way back.

lines.zh: 火球在我手里越来越热。
lines.en: The fireball grows hotter in my hand.
You heard the laughter, did you not?
A little longer, then I throw.
The nether's hot wind covers me.
You turn, and I retreat.
My wings are already spread.

lines.zh: 这段距离刚好在射程内。
lines.en: This is well within range.
Now — I fly out.
The fireball bursts at your feet.

lines.zh: 我贴上去，爪子烧红了你。
lines.en: I press close; my claws sear you.
I open my palm and fire sprays out.

lines.zh: 我飞到你背后扔了一个。
lines.en: I fly behind you and throw one.
Smoke goes straight down your throat.
I land and laugh louder.
You lunge, and I fly clear.

lines.zh: 这一下烧到了你的靴子。
lines.en: That caught your boots.
My fireball went a little wide.
A stone by the lava bursts.
I gather another, quickly.
You retreat behind the pillar. Perfect.
I wait for you to come out.

lines.zh: 火星落在我脚边，我踢开。
lines.en: Sparks fall at my feet and I kick them aside.
You are still smoking.
Next time I throw two.

lines.zh: 我从熔岩的裂缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a crack in the lava.

lines.zh: 玄武岩上多了个小影子。
lines.en: There is one more small shadow on the basalt.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先点着，然后是我。
lines.en: My tail lit first; then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 下界的空气让我精神起来。
lines.en: The Nether's air sharpens me.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，火星四散。
lines.en: I shake my wings and sparks scatter.

lines.zh: 我蹲在岩柱顶上，看着你。
lines.en: I squat on a pillar top and watch you.

lines.zh: 我把火球在手里抛了两下。
lines.en: I toss a fireball twice in my hand.
I know this heat.
I laugh once first.

lines.zh: 我绕着熔岩池边跑了一圈。
lines.en: I run one lap around the lava pool.

lines.zh: 我的脚尖落地，石头就响。
lines.en: My toes touch down and the stone ticks.

lines.zh: 我从火里走出，身上没灰。
lines.en: I walk out of the fire without a speck of ash.
I see fresh footprints.
This time I am in no hurry.
Fire is nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我砸在岩柱上，摔得发晕。
lines.en: I hit a pillar and land stunned.

lines.zh: 水对我很陌生，我拼命挣扎。
lines.en: Water is strange to me, and I thrash.
The blast throws me into the rock.

lines.zh: 冰凉的箭头卡在翅膀上。
lines.en: A cold arrowhead sticks in my wing.

lines.zh: 一股冷意让我打了个抖。
lines.en: A coldness makes me shiver.
Hunger has weakened my fire.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我被震得耳鸣。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my ears ring.

lines.zh: 这里没有热，我直往下掉。
lines.en: There is no heat here, and I fall.
